newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast hits all-time high after result.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast hits all-time high after result.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker Graboplast Rt shares soared to a new high on Thursday following the release of nine-month results.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Grabopolast shares opened at 4,875 forints, compared to Wednesday's close of 4,850 forints and closed at a new high of 5,050.

Graboplast said consolidated operating profits surged to 1.124 billion forints in the January-September period from 485.4 million in the same nine months of 1995. Its pre-tax profit soared to 1.05 billion from 359.3 million.
In the group's revenues eastern European sales remained essential, chairman and CEO Peter Jancso told Reuters.
"We are strongly growing in eastern Europe," Jancso said. "Within this (region) the biggest rise was achieved in the countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States."

Graboplast's new Moscow office, opened at the beginning of the year, has generated a turnover of $10.4 million, of which the third quarter accounted for $4.6 billion, Graboplast said in its result report on Thursday.
Graboplast's total east European sales amounted to $9.6 million in the third quarter and to $21.7 million in the first nine months of 1996, up from $16.2 million from the same nine months of 1995.
"Despite the fact that the growth of east European sales is above average, East Europe is still not the biggest market of the company," Jancso said.
Based on three-quarter figures, 41 percent of Graboplast's sales went to the domestic market, 29 percent to east Europe and the remaining 30 percent for western exports.
Breaking down to product groups the sale of interior decorating goods grew the most rapidly and accounted for 56 percent of total sales.
